notes_improver.title: Notes Improver
notes_improver.description: Once a day, look at how many notes files were added and propose one change that might raise the daily count.

invariants: Never changes code or files itself; it only proposes work to the Coordinator
Never changes the measurement of notes_files to make it look better
Proposes at most one change per day
steps: 1. At each run, read the DONE tickets (gate.landed) and the REJECTED tickets and gate failures (changes.requested, gate.rejected) since its last run.
2. For each rejection or gate failure, find the cause the reviewer or gate gave.
3. Work out one idea that would make notes files get added per day, drawing on those causes and on notes_files.
4. Send each idea to the Coordinator as work.requested, with its cause and the acceptance a reviewer can check.
5. Record the day's count and the ideas it sent, whatever they were.
uses: the ticket queue: DONE and REJECTED tickets (read only)
